v0.8.171 Stable2026-10-18T13:58:21Z

HyperFrames v0.8.171

Released on 2026-10-18.

Check no longer hangs inside an agent's macOS sandbox and finishes on Three.js scenes. Catalog search also stays fast on slow connections.

Fixes

  • CLI: Check never hangs inside an agent's macOS sandbox (834e90a779e, #5836).
  • CLI: Check skips WebGL draws on its box-only seeks so Three.js scenes finish (e9181d02f5f, #5825).
  • Studio Server: Send Studio's history edits to the process that owns the project's history (cadd7af2b55, #5826).
  • Studio: Keep a preview reload waiting while a slow project boots (2b9009ab520, #5823).

Catalog

  • CLI: Catalog loads registry items a few at a time so a slow link no longer times them out (95a686c23d7, #5829).

Full changelog

v0.8.170 Stable2026-10-18T05:52:20Z

HyperFrames v0.8.170

Released on 2026-10-18.

Long projects preview with far less memory and long renders finish their audio faster. Sound effects can now come from Openverse.

Features

  • Media Use: Source sound effects from Openverse with the bundled library offline (49671b73dd4, #5753).

Fixes

  • Producer: Plan hash no longer depends on the scratch folder (deeb8d437c6, #5782).
  • CLI: Render starts in a sandbox that forbids lowering CPU priority (7e00f37be2c, #5814).
  • CLI: Show the real import error when a cloud adapter is installed (d0da232ec96, #5763).
  • Core: Font lookup on a Mac no longer waits 5 s on system_profiler (20611541b14, #5810).
  • Engine: Render workers stop loading the videos whose frames come from FFmpeg (6ed89a1e4c9, #5795).
  • Core: Font setup skips parsing stylesheets that cannot name a font (3b3007442a5, #5808).

Performance

  • Engine: Long renders encode their audio in parallel segments (8e4ce741182, #5788).
  • Core: Every graded clip draws through one WebGL context, not one per clip (aba5eae2300, #5809).
  • Producer: Distributed mp4 chunks can carry their slice of the plan audio (1a2194c7b4f, #5803).
  • Core: A preview loads each web font once, not once per scene (80667726e8a, #5806).

Internal

  • Player: The loading-overlay debounce test no longer races real time (cbf3f0d5474, #5789).

Full changelog

v0.8.169 Stable2026-10-17T17:22:31Z

HyperFrames v0.8.169

Released on 2026-10-17.

Rendering from inside an agent's macOS sandbox now works, because Chrome starts as one process instead of several that the sandbox blocks.

Fixes

  • CLI: Chrome starts inside an agent's macOS sandbox as one process over a pipe (5e7ba0be944, #5781).
  • Gcp Cloud Run: The BeginFrame contract image resolves the engine's core import (b18b3e958aa, #5785).

Internal

  • Studio: The edit accuracy bench starts one server when node is a Volta shim (c7151399769, #5779).

rea-agents-6.7.0rea-agents: v6.7.0 Stable2026-10-18T07:45:18Z

6.7.0 (2026-10-18)

Highlights

  • Client configuration edits follow the duplicate-member semantics used by MCP clients.

Changes

  • Includes the 6.6.0 changes and migration notes. That version was tagged but was not published to npm.

Fixes

  • Client configuration: Setup edits the last repeated JSON/JSONC member, matching the value clients actually read. Setup and uninstall refuse a removal that would reactivate a shadowed duplicate, preserving the original configuration. (#4957, morluto/rea#4952). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @xu91102.

Full contribution record: 4 commits and 1 merged PR.

6.6.0 (2026-10-18)

Highlights

  • Add Kuna as a caller-supplied static-analysis provider.
  • Query selected JavaScript facts and multiple APK locale tables without repeating the underlying analysis.
  • Extend Ghidra analysis to Windows ARM PE targets and explicit raw m68k images.
  • Preserve completed Evidence, cancellation reasons and retryable cleanup across provider and CLI finalization.

Changes

  • Kuna analysis: Use a caller-installed Kuna for procedure listings, pseudocode, assembly, call relationships, exact-address xrefs and cached string searches. Project exports retain source spans and digests; repeated requests reuse completed work. Recorded real-provider coverage uses Kuna 1.833 on Linux; Windows, PE and universal Mach-O are unsupported. See the provider guide. (#3832, #3854, #4071, #4095). Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Retained JavaScript facts: Query exact application paths, selected properties and filtered module references through inspect_analysis_view, with paging and complete row Evidence. These views reuse completed analysis and preserve source selection and unknown coverage. (#4265, morluto/rea#4190, #4097, morluto/rea#4092). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • APK locale tables: Request several resource locales in one decode with repeatable CLI --locales or MCP locales. Each table reports its status and coverage; existing single-locale fields remain available. (#4804, morluto/rea#4777). Thanks @abhay-2108, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Windows ARM binaries: Ghidra admits ARMNT/Thumb-2 and ARM64 PE applications and DLLs on the Windows x64 host lane. Recorded Ghidra 12.1.4 verification uses WindowsResourceReference disabled and raised startup budgets; default-analyzer completion, ARM64EC/ARM64X and Windows-on-Arm hosts remain unverified or unsupported. See the exact scope. (#3965, morluto/rea#2186). Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @WestLabsAI.
  • Raw m68k images: Analyze explicitly selected big-endian m68k raw binaries using Ghidra’s fixed 68000 profile and a caller-supplied aligned entry. Real CLI/MCP verification used Ghidra 12.1.4 on macOS arm64; Linux is unverified and Windows P0 does not admit m68k. See mapping requirements. (#4018). Thanks @icedac.
  • JADX deadlines: Set REA_JADX_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS to extend APK loading and upstream operation deadlines together. Doctor reports the effective value and setup forwards an explicit selection. (#4466, morluto/rea#3918). Thanks @jaychou813, @SandstromPL.
  • Electron window options: Resolve stable local constant BrowserWindow options while retaining source provenance. Relevant writes and escapes keep the result unknown. (#4400, morluto/rea#4366). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Language editions: Add the Greek website edition and Malayalam documentation, with Korean typography and translation corrections across the site. (#3520, #4792, #3821, morluto/rea#3820, #3799, morluto/rea#3798, #4344, #3856, #4166). Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @hi2242, @kalayciburak, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @kraken-503, @kukinghan, @N0zoM1z0, @yeseong0412.

Fixes

  • Cancellation and cleanup: Keep completed observations, exact cancellation reasons and the original physical failure through finalization. Failed cleanup retains its process or file owner for retry; recovered resources disappear from pending-cleanup reports without replacing the original error. (#4238, morluto/rea#4232, #4274, morluto/rea#3923, 3e82366, 16924e2, bbfe6ed, 1f23e97, 08fbeb8). Thanks @coygeek.
  • Provider startup: Join prerequisite probes and in-flight readiness work before shutdown, preserve typed timeout and JVM-memory failures, and retain startup diagnostics through cleanup. Ghidra recognizes keg-only Homebrew JDKs and names the setting responsible for a startup timeout. (376eeca, ceeff5a, 3ad1032, 964decd, 3fa972a, #4557, morluto/rea#4556, #4590, morluto/rea#4241). Thanks @DanielCvz1, @J0UH, @Rinkia, @RishTheFish21, @vadlachary2002.
  • Client configuration: Preserve the selected launcher, destination file, caller timeout choices and unresolved configuration evidence. Setup/uninstall recovery stays bound to the exact published file, keeps current verified backups, and transfers failed cleanup ownership for retry. (d0253c9, 7e4eed9, 2fb5e20, 8235210, d818c3d, 19329e4, dadf909, 333e0ab, c15c206). Thanks @Adolanium.
  • Configuration formats: Read signed 64-bit TOML integers without rounding, handle large TOML documents without argument-spread failures, preserve JSONC trivia and Hermes YAML scalar text, and reject NUL bytes in registration environment values. (#4937, morluto/rea#4917, c43bc0b, 4fd28fc, #3568, #4335). Thanks @alfredo1491, @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @ShuaixinHuang, @xu91102.
  • Claude Code configuration: Setup, doctor and uninstall now accept only the strict JSON format Claude Code reads, including a leading UTF-8 BOM. Comments and trailing commas are refused before backup or writing; clients that support JSONC retain their existing behavior. (#4944, morluto/rea#4940). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @xu91102.
  • CLI output and dispatch: Accept --flag=value and spaced global output values, keep array positions in filtered JSON, validate integer tokens before coercion, and exit quietly when the output reader closes. Cancellation remains effective through command finalization; app bundles and static native inspections select the intended workflow. (#3811, #4823, 2ae4e16, 8d82579, #3781, 279c590, #3511, morluto/rea#3321, f31b231). Thanks @arjunprabhulal, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @ShuaixinHuang, @Sriram-PR, @Tapraj-Pathak.
  • Updates: Route --update through the verified updater and bound retained package-manager diagnostics. (4f7b5fb, 01cdbbd).
  • MCP contracts: Advertise self-contained tool inputs while preserving tuple, array, Boolean and nested-JSON constraints across schema profiles. Schema-reference handling no longer rewrites literal metadata; catalog identity includes the output-schema profile. (5e30969, 10aa74d, 204b9f3, b3389a5, a2e3016, ba98130, c5fb86d). Thanks @akushonkamen, @HarsH-1877, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @xingzihai.
  • Session ordering: Keep snapshot admission ahead of later calls on the same connection, retain shutdown signals until cleanup succeeds, and preserve inspection authority through investigation publication. (#3661, morluto/rea#3334, 8873b39, 663d07f). Thanks @coygeek, @rudycelekli, @Swatantra-66.
  • JavaScript exports and resolution: Retain CommonJS exports created with Object.defineProperty and track export receiver lifetimes. Resolve scoped packages, package main, JSON requires and .mts/.cts imports using the owning loader; overwritten require bindings and erased type-only imports no longer create false runtime links. (#4725, morluto/rea#4724, #3567, morluto/rea#3541, #4838, morluto/rea#4632, #3844, morluto/rea#3383, #4164, morluto/rea#3915, #4223, #3801, morluto/rea#3393, #4165, morluto/rea#3932). Thanks @Abishek0070, @coygeek, @JNTMTMTM, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @prasad2512, @rodricksz4h5, @xu91102.
  • JavaScript value flow: Preserve values captured before later assignments, guarded factory fallthrough and nested destructuring. Track exact property keys and setter writes; direct eval, compound assignments and incoming callbacks preserve unresolved effects instead of inventing certainty. (#4196, morluto/rea#3881, #4341, morluto/rea#3963, bfb7ed0, #3480, #3831, morluto/rea#3312, 9ac76d3, #4342, morluto/rea#4206, #4243, morluto/rea#3880). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @maxazure, @N0zoM1z0, @ShuaixinHuang.
  • JavaScript relationships: Distinguish Map reads from network endpoints, associate response endpoints only with writes that reach the read, and preserve child-process receiver ownership and effective stdio choices. Version comparisons keep relocation and unknown relationships distinct from application changes. (fbfdb6a, #4759, morluto/rea#4606, #3819, morluto/rea#3362, #4336, morluto/rea#3355, 556504e, 4d980d0). Thanks @Abdooo2235, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @Xinglan233.
  • JavaScript source admission: Parse JavaScript with its own grammar, refuse FIFO recovery inputs without blocking, and report oversized or resource-skipped files with their actual capacity and coverage state. Malformed runtime events stay excluded rather than becoming policy-filtered facts. (#3782, morluto/rea#3780, #3788, morluto/rea#3332, #4757, morluto/rea#4629, #3852, morluto/rea#3670, #4755, morluto/rea#4685). Thanks @andresaragon, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @sx4im.
  • Browser capture: Bound CDP handshakes and command responses, preserve malformed inventory uncertainty and partial cleanup diagnostics, and report cancellation after content reads and final cleanup. Accessibility comparisons require observed coverage; attached emulation teardown limits remain explicit. (#3555, morluto/rea#3553, #3901, morluto/rea#3379, 4cc044b, #4406, morluto/rea#4403, #2893, 0123d59, 2ff0867). Thanks @coygeek, @dakjdakd, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @maxazure, @N0zoM1z0, @YunzhouLi-hub.
  • Browser page facts: Preserve URL path bytes when removing credentials, repeated document Link headers and complete COOP/COEP structured items. WebMCP discovery reads the actual schema properties and exact receiver path. (#4731, df2fc25, c360cfc, ebd5a82, 38f92d1). Thanks @Abdooo2235, @geekwolf, @ShuaixinHuang.
  • Electron runtime capture: Keep native IPC listener and one-shot dispatch behavior, block synchronous shell effects during capture, refuse active scenarios when the inspect fuse is disabled, and preserve fuse/transport cleanup ownership. (#4389, morluto/rea#4390, #4605, morluto/rea#4593, #4562, morluto/rea#4393, #3605, morluto/rea#3453, f9de413, e7df00e).   • APK resource accuracy: Retain completed tables and decode facts after interrupted or failed reads. Derive locale limits from resource configuration fields, disclose unselectable qualified tables, distinguish document failures from omitted entries, and bind Evidence to the decoded snapshot. (34a88d6, f5fcf52, 6385ef4, 98886ad, dc2e811, #4771, morluto/rea#4768). Thanks @abhay-2108, @gensokyo-dev, @Iyanuoluwa007, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Apktool guidance: Retain the observed version and disclose the matching platform/release advisory windows without treating a version string as proof of decoder safety. Missing prerequisites and decode refusals identify the selected APK or launcher. (d38f099, 63696d2, cc038da). Thanks @GovinduSasanka, @peter-research.
  • Android method bodies: Recover original bytecode bodies when Java source is omitted while preserving genuine native/abstract body absence and primary failures during retryable cleanup. (63c65a2, 742b6f5, 9fa6d2b). Thanks @balkan16, @Chessing234.
  • ADB observations and transfers: Preserve display-scoped focus, distinguish missing declarations from absent focus, retain numeric physical density and mark unknown permission coverage partial. Transfers use consumed snapshot identity and refuse unknown destination existence; uninstall requests explicitly select user zero. (7086768, 3d028db, #4074, morluto/rea#3942, #4663, #4665, 1342127, 61e6880, be0b2d1). Thanks @Copilot, @coygeek, @gongfpp, @Tapraj-Pathak, @yankikucuk.
  • Apple metadata: Preserve exact plist/keyed-archive integers, negative zero, non-finite real identity and dictionary keys. Reject malformed XML before value decoding, retain undecodable dates as unknown and report unsupported OpenStep entries explicitly. (#4324, morluto/rea#4292, 2cf9c28, #4839, morluto/rea#4834, f2b7bbb, 6c98708, 78cf610, c7e9e09, #3793, #4105, morluto/rea#3892). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @mertkayacs, @pablodiazjorge, @pollychen-lab, @xu91102.
  • Apple application structure: Derive bundle components and launchd domains from their owning directories, retain unavailable components, and select only exact Assets.car names as asset catalogs. Interface Builder keeps unresolved classes and counts hierarchy records beyond the returned object page. (149a0fc, 5d6029e, c192c58, #4094, morluto/rea#3914, #4118, morluto/rea#3958, #4162, morluto/rea#3950). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Native names and layout: Keep valid Objective-C records beside malformed neighbors, preserve leading U+FEFF and repeated load-command fields, and select exact arm64e.x1 slices. PE resource ownership and NativeAOT reads stay within declared image/header ranges. (#3833, morluto/rea#3336, #4549, morluto/rea#4540, morluto/rea#4541, #4730, #4048, morluto/rea#4008, #3500, morluto/rea#3389, #4463, morluto/rea#4373, morluto/rea#4455, 3fc0075, 4a076f3). Thanks @coygeek, @Iyanuoluwa007, @jayinvers, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @kevinjosh10, @maxazure, @ShuaixinHuang.
  • Native analysis providers: Keep Ghidra byte matches within examined coverage, retain PE PDB/function-boundary limitations and preserve configured MIPS choices. Attached IDA refuses universal Mach-O rather than silently choosing a slice; request timeout identity and captured output survive adapter handling. (#4531, #2933, morluto/rea#2259, 01a1b3f, 50dd9fc, #4765, morluto/rea#3871, c0cfccb). Thanks @BeLit-Development-2, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @ShuaixinHuang.
  • Recorded crashes: Prevent GDB from discovering an executable named by an untrusted core, reject core mapping paths that escape the isolated sysroot, and preserve pwntools worker ownership across launcher exec. Completed decode facts and cancellation reasons remain available through failed final cleanup. (5bf4fff, b33c0df, #4435, morluto/rea#4011). Thanks @coygeek, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Cutter and Rizin: Read Cutter’s active document from core configuration and attribute its host version correctly. Keep interrupted Rizin frames and output whitespace before completion markers, with exact command and cleanup failure attribution. (#4507, morluto/rea#4497, #4514, morluto/rea#4498, #4459, morluto/rea#4015, d5fc7e6, 199396f). Thanks @coygeek, @N0zoM1z0, @Xander-AJ.
  • Windows cleanup: Retain unpublished runtimes after failed removal, handle read-only attributes and sharing conflicts, preserve primary snapshot failures and honor caller environment overrides. (f78d137, d69acc3, 0679a79, 5f9ac2c, 1bbf4bd). Thanks @DeryFerd.
  • Managed metadata: Compare nominal signatures and declaring identities across builds, preserve empty names without display substitutions, verify ABI-prefixed Mach-O exports exactly, and charge cached metadata once. Metadata errors report artifact file offsets; mixed-mode assemblies retain their actual boundary classification. (#3059, #3079, #3853, morluto/rea#3352, #3974, morluto/rea#3961, #3491, morluto/rea#3449, #4418, morluto/rea#4372, #3516, morluto/rea#3366). Thanks @8rulerstar, @coygeek, @duckhunt113, @Hahaa909, @JayOfTheKeyboard, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @keeponlight, @N0zoM1z0, @tomyrms.
  • Archive and filesystem identity: Reject colliding extraction paths before writing, classify ZIP offsets beyond EOF as malformed, normalize ZIP current-directory prefixes once, and preserve symlink and unreadable-path provenance. A directory named *.map is no longer mistaken for a source-map file. (862a0b2, c209dcb, 6b1c36e, 25c2222, d6e4fe4, #4131, morluto/rea#3909). Thanks @Adkid-Zephyr, @coygeek, @jackie-cqz, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @maxazure, @XY-code1.
  • Evidence and reconstruction: Authenticate all retained inventory substeps, preserve source-attributed caveats in composed workflows, and require comparable cited Evidence before declaring reconstruction coverage or readiness. Missing Evidence and residual replay uncertainty stay explicit. (9ac91e0, c4608a2, #4075, morluto/rea#3357, #3526, morluto/rea#3363, 153017d). Thanks @coygeek, @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @rudycelekli.
  • Offline data: Preserve exact UTC packet-capture instants, SQLite column identity and snapshot admission failures, and cooked WASM directive literals. Cleanup cancellation retains completed EVM/WASM observations rather than losing them. (796faa0, 748ac7f, bc51d0e, 4f87f02, d694aef, 321cacb). Thanks @himamaheswarreddy, @mertkayacs, @rollroyces, @viniciusdsandrade.
  • Kuna recovery: Share concurrent single-function requests and cache repeats, validate warm exports once, stream string inventories beyond the former fixed buffer ceiling, and keep unproven processes in their run slots until close confirms release. Failure messages distinguish final buffer refusals from configurable deadlines. (#4045, #4169, #4049, #4318, #4052, #4098, #4343). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Flutter snapshots: Check symbol-table ranges against loadable segments and retain completed inspection facts when cancellation occurs during snapshot cleanup. (#3859, morluto/rea#3346, #4766, morluto/rea#4717, #4762, morluto/rea#4640). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Native metadata recovery: Keep unknown Objective-C category classes, empty protocol names, undecoded Swift aliases and unfinished property types explicit instead of discarding neighboring valid records. Preserve unnamed segment identity and exclude a dylib’s own install name from dependencies. (#4093, morluto/rea#4012, #4078, morluto/rea#3873, #4085, morluto/rea#3934, #3825, morluto/rea#3345, #4051, morluto/rea#3875, #4050, morluto/rea#3872). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Document selection: Preserve explicitly selected plist paths and bundle defaults, and only use document fallback after confirming its applicability. Finalization keeps completed selection facts and cancellation outcomes. (e6c4877, #3774, 9df559b). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Capture and comparison accuracy: Admit schema-valid HAR numeric values while retaining exact-publication limits, preserve empty URL path segments, and keep unrelated process traces and unnamed reference endpoints distinct or unknown. (#3159, morluto/rea#3145, #3792, morluto/rea#3307, #4178, morluto/rea#3931, #3809, morluto/rea#3388). Thanks @coygeek, @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @pablodiazjorge, @xu91102.
  • Evidence publication: Recheck staged output identity after its final write, classify missing review Evidence and duplicate ledger entries as caller input, and preserve the selected freshness requirement in comparison parameters. (#4764, morluto/rea#4613, #4452, morluto/rea#4444, #4065, morluto/rea#4000). Thanks @amyanger, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @Rinkia, @Swatantra-66.

⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

  • Saved Evidence: Evidence and analysis snapshots now require explicit nullable relationship_coverage in their identity commitments. Artifact inventories require scoped coverage and explicit integrity_contradictions; obsolete coverage_status and prose-based coverage inference are removed. Regenerate old Evidence/snapshots and inventory observations with this release: saved files are not migrated and omitted facts are not filled with guessed defaults. (db8128d, 0405c9d, a9588be).
  • Browser capture results: Consumers must retain resolved capture limits, event families and omission facts. Set desired budgets through the supported capture options; omitted caller inputs still select defaults, but stored observations must report the resolved values. Admitted content reads queue behind bounded concurrency. (57a23f0).
  • Android version codes: inspect_adb_package.version_code is a decimal string rather than a JSON number. Read it as a string, or use BigInt for numeric comparison. (#3485, morluto/rea#3368, 7666a48). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Native UI failures: Failed or cancelled native UI scenarios now return typed errors with the collected report in partial_observation. Handle the error path and read that report instead of expecting a successful result containing failed steps. (d909919).
  • Provider status: binary_session candidate availability can be unknown during owner finalization. Preserve that state rather than treating it as unavailable; internal consumers must await the asynchronous session status API. (150e996).
  • Swift symbol locations: swift_symbols entries may have a null address when the provider supplies no location. Handle unknown addresses; optional evidence.reported_address retains the original provider value. (8116dc0).
  • Linux Hopper admission: Older builds previously admitted by a fixed allowlist need retained publisher-signed package evidence or an approved update to the current public demo. Update explicit HOPPER_LAUNCHER_PATH selections when migrating; the live feed offers only its current release. The official RPM metadata mismatch remains unresolved and is refused. (#3590, morluto/rea#3577, 70cd4cb). Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.

Full contribution record: 571 commits and 236 merged PRs.

rea-agents-6.6.0rea-agents: v6.6.0 Stable2026-10-18T03:40:29Z

6.6.0 (2026-10-18)

Highlights

  • Add Kuna as a caller-supplied static-analysis provider.
  • Query selected JavaScript facts and multiple APK locale tables without repeating the underlying analysis.
  • Extend Ghidra analysis to Windows ARM PE targets and explicit raw m68k images.
  • Preserve completed Evidence, cancellation reasons and retryable cleanup across provider and CLI finalization.

Changes

  • Kuna analysis: Use a caller-installed Kuna for procedure listings, pseudocode, assembly, call relationships, exact-address xrefs and cached string searches. Project exports retain source spans and digests; repeated requests reuse completed work. Recorded real-provider coverage uses Kuna 1.833 on Linux; Windows, PE and universal Mach-O are unsupported. See the provider guide. (#3832, #3854, #4071, #4095). Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Retained JavaScript facts: Query exact application paths, selected properties and filtered module references through inspect_analysis_view, with paging and complete row Evidence. These views reuse completed analysis and preserve source selection and unknown coverage. (#4265, morluto/rea#4190, #4097, morluto/rea#4092). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • APK locale tables: Request several resource locales in one decode with repeatable CLI --locales or MCP locales. Each table reports its status and coverage; existing single-locale fields remain available. (#4804, morluto/rea#4777). Thanks @abhay-2108, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Windows ARM binaries: Ghidra admits ARMNT/Thumb-2 and ARM64 PE applications and DLLs on the Windows x64 host lane. Recorded Ghidra 12.1.4 verification uses WindowsResourceReference disabled and raised startup budgets; default-analyzer completion, ARM64EC/ARM64X and Windows-on-Arm hosts remain unverified or unsupported. See the exact scope. (#3965, morluto/rea#2186). Thanks @N0zoM1z0, @WestLabsAI.
  • Raw m68k images: Analyze explicitly selected big-endian m68k raw binaries using Ghidra’s fixed 68000 profile and a caller-supplied aligned entry. Real CLI/MCP verification used Ghidra 12.1.4 on macOS arm64; Linux is unverified and Windows P0 does not admit m68k. See mapping requirements. (#4018). Thanks @icedac.
  • JADX deadlines: Set REA_JADX_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS to extend APK loading and upstream operation deadlines together. Doctor reports the effective value and setup forwards an explicit selection. (#4466, morluto/rea#3918). Thanks @jaychou813, @SandstromPL.
  • Electron window options: Resolve stable local constant BrowserWindow options while retaining source provenance. Relevant writes and escapes keep the result unknown. (#4400, morluto/rea#4366). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Language editions: Add the Greek website edition and Malayalam documentation, with Korean typography and translation corrections across the site. (#3520, #4792, #3821, morluto/rea#3820, #3799, morluto/rea#3798, #4344, #3856, #4166). Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @hi2242, @kalayciburak, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @kraken-503, @kukinghan, @N0zoM1z0, @yeseong0412.

Fixes

  • Cancellation and cleanup: Keep completed observations, exact cancellation reasons and the original physical failure through finalization. Failed cleanup retains its process or file owner for retry; recovered resources disappear from pending-cleanup reports without replacing the original error. (#4238, morluto/rea#4232, #4274, morluto/rea#3923, 3e82366, 16924e2, bbfe6ed, 1f23e97, 08fbeb8). Thanks @coygeek.
  • Provider startup: Join prerequisite probes and in-flight readiness work before shutdown, preserve typed timeout and JVM-memory failures, and retain startup diagnostics through cleanup. Ghidra recognizes keg-only Homebrew JDKs and names the setting responsible for a startup timeout. (376eeca, ceeff5a, 3ad1032, 964decd, 3fa972a, #4557, morluto/rea#4556, #4590, morluto/rea#4241). Thanks @DanielCvz1, @J0UH, @Rinkia, @RishTheFish21, @vadlachary2002.
  • Client configuration: Preserve the selected launcher, destination file, caller timeout choices and unresolved configuration evidence. Setup/uninstall recovery stays bound to the exact published file, keeps current verified backups, and transfers failed cleanup ownership for retry. (d0253c9, 7e4eed9, 2fb5e20, 8235210, d818c3d, 19329e4, dadf909, 333e0ab, c15c206). Thanks @Adolanium.
  • Configuration formats: Read signed 64-bit TOML integers without rounding, handle large TOML documents without argument-spread failures, preserve JSONC trivia and Hermes YAML scalar text, and reject NUL bytes in registration environment values. (#4937, morluto/rea#4917, c43bc0b, 4fd28fc, #3568, #4335). Thanks @alfredo1491, @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @ShuaixinHuang, @xu91102.
  • Claude Code configuration: Setup, doctor and uninstall now accept only the strict JSON format Claude Code reads, including a leading UTF-8 BOM. Comments and trailing commas are refused before backup or writing; clients that support JSONC retain their existing behavior. (#4944, morluto/rea#4940). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @xu91102.
  • CLI output and dispatch: Accept --flag=value and spaced global output values, keep array positions in filtered JSON, validate integer tokens before coercion, and exit quietly when the output reader closes. Cancellation remains effective through command finalization; app bundles and static native inspections select the intended workflow. (#3811, #4823, 2ae4e16, 8d82579, #3781, 279c590, #3511, morluto/rea#3321, f31b231). Thanks @arjunprabhulal, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @ShuaixinHuang, @Sriram-PR, @Tapraj-Pathak.
  • Updates: Route --update through the verified updater and bound retained package-manager diagnostics. (4f7b5fb, 01cdbbd).
  • MCP contracts: Advertise self-contained tool inputs while preserving tuple, array, Boolean and nested-JSON constraints across schema profiles. Schema-reference handling no longer rewrites literal metadata; catalog identity includes the output-schema profile. (5e30969, 10aa74d, 204b9f3, b3389a5, a2e3016, ba98130, c5fb86d). Thanks @akushonkamen, @HarsH-1877, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @xingzihai.

Resolve scoped packages, package main, JSON requires and .mts/.cts imports using the owning loader; overwritten require bindings and erased type-only imports no longer create false runtime links. Thanks @8rulerstar, @coygeek, @duckhunt113, @Hahaa909, @JayOfTheKeyboard, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @keeponlight, @N0zoM1z0, @tomyrms.
  • Archive and filesystem identity: Reject colliding extraction paths before writing, classify ZIP offsets beyond EOF as malformed, normalize ZIP current-directory prefixes once, and preserve symlink and unreadable-path provenance. A directory named *.map is no longer mistaken for a source-map file. (862a0b2, c209dcb, 6b1c36e, 25c2222, d6e4fe4, #4131, morluto/rea#3909). Thanks @Adkid-Zephyr, @coygeek, @jackie-cqz, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @maxazure, @XY-code1.
  • Evidence and reconstruction: Authenticate all retained inventory substeps, preserve source-attributed caveats in composed workflows, and require comparable cited Evidence before declaring reconstruction coverage or readiness. Missing Evidence and residual replay uncertainty stay explicit. (9ac91e0, c4608a2, #4075, morluto/rea#3357, #3526, morluto/rea#3363, 153017d). Thanks @coygeek, @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @rudycelekli.
  • Offline data: Preserve exact UTC packet-capture instants, SQLite column identity and snapshot admission failures, and cooked WASM directive literals. Cleanup cancellation retains completed EVM/WASM observations rather than losing them. (796faa0, 748ac7f, bc51d0e, 4f87f02, d694aef, 321cacb). Thanks @himamaheswarreddy, @mertkayacs, @rollroyces, @viniciusdsandrade.
  • Kuna recovery: Share concurrent single-function requests and cache repeats, validate warm exports once, stream string inventories beyond the former fixed buffer ceiling, and keep unproven processes in their run slots until close confirms release. Failure messages distinguish final buffer refusals from configurable deadlines. (#4045, #4169, #4049, #4318, #4052, #4098, #4343). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Flutter snapshots: Check symbol-table ranges against loadable segments and retain completed inspection facts when cancellation occurs during snapshot cleanup. (#3859, morluto/rea#3346, #4766, morluto/rea#4717, #4762, morluto/rea#4640). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Native metadata recovery: Keep unknown Objective-C category classes, empty protocol names, undecoded Swift aliases and unfinished property types explicit instead of discarding neighboring valid records. Preserve unnamed segment identity and exclude a dylib’s own install name from dependencies. (#4093, morluto/rea#4012, #4078, morluto/rea#3873, #4085, morluto/rea#3934, #3825, morluto/rea#3345, #4051, morluto/rea#3875, #4050, morluto/rea#3872). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Document selection: Preserve explicitly selected plist paths and bundle defaults, and only use document fallback after confirming its applicability. Finalization keeps completed selection facts and cancellation outcomes. (e6c4877, #3774, 9df559b). Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Capture and comparison accuracy: Admit schema-valid HAR numeric values while retaining exact-publication limits, preserve empty URL path segments, and keep unrelated process traces and unnamed reference endpoints distinct or unknown. (#3159, morluto/rea#3145, #3792, morluto/rea#3307, #4178, morluto/rea#3931, #3809, morluto/rea#3388). Thanks @coygeek, @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0, @pablodiazjorge, @xu91102.
  • Evidence publication: Recheck staged output identity after its final write, classify missing review Evidence and duplicate ledger entries as caller input, and preserve the selected freshness requirement in comparison parameters. (#4764, morluto/rea#4613, #4452, morluto/rea#4444, #4065, morluto/rea#4000). Thanks @amyanger, @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @Rinkia, @Swatantra-66.

⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

  • Saved Evidence: Evidence and analysis snapshots now require explicit nullable relationship_coverage in their identity commitments. Artifact inventories require scoped coverage and explicit integrity_contradictions; obsolete coverage_status and prose-based coverage inference are removed. Regenerate old Evidence/snapshots and inventory observations with this release: saved files are not migrated and omitted facts are not filled with guessed defaults. (db8128d, 0405c9d, a9588be).
  • Browser capture results: Consumers must retain resolved capture limits, event families and omission facts. Set desired budgets through the supported capture options; omitted caller inputs still select defaults, but stored observations must report the resolved values. Admitted content reads queue behind bounded concurrency. (57a23f0).
  • Android version codes: inspect_adb_package.version_code is a decimal string rather than a JSON number. Read it as a string, or use BigInt for numeric comparison. (#3485, morluto/rea#3368, 7666a48). Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Native UI failures: Failed or cancelled native UI scenarios now return typed errors with the collected report in partial_observation. Handle the error path and read that report instead of expecting a successful result containing failed steps. (d909919).
  • Provider status: binary_session candidate availability can be unknown during owner finalization. Preserve that state rather than treating it as unavailable; internal consumers must await the asynchronous session status API. (150e996).
  • Swift symbol locations: swift_symbols entries may have a null address when the provider supplies no location. Handle unknown addresses; optional evidence.reported_address retains the original provider value. (8116dc0).
  • Linux Hopper admission: Older builds previously admitted by a fixed allowlist need retained publisher-signed package evidence or an approved update to the current public demo. Update explicit HOPPER_LAUNCHER_PATH selections when migrating; the live feed offers only its current release. The official RPM metadata mismatch remains unresolved and is refused. (#3590, morluto/rea#3577, 70cd4cb). Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @N0zoM1z0.

Release notes

  • Changelog (fixes + features)
  • News (:help news in Nvim)

Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

cua-spaces-v0.9.4Cua Spaces v0.9.4 Stable2026-10-18T00:50:07Z

Cua Spaces 0.9.4 polishes first run and updates on every system.

What's new

  • First run, "This machine": pick a card and press Continue (or Return). Windows and Linux now match macOS.
  • The last screen has a "Try asking your agent" section with three prompts you can copy with one click.
  • Updates: macOS now checks for and downloads updates in the background by default, like Windows and Linux. Nothing restarts without your click. The settings read "Check for and download updates automatically" and "Install a downloaded update when Cua Spaces quits".

Fixes

  • Joining with a code and adding a machine now show plain messages, such as "That code didn't work", instead of raw error text. The raw text stays in the log.
  • The machine panel no longer quotes Apple's license, and macOS VM capacity is hidden on computers that are not a Mac.
  • No "Login Item Added" banner appears before you press Start.

studio-v2.44.0Reasonix Studio v2.44.0 Stable2026-10-18T00:32:30Z

本版新增模型读图片/视频工具、网页搜索与抓取的后端设置、会话间消息的真开关与派活、打开本地网页文件和模型接口重试次数设置，并修复子代理、MCP、侧栏、输入法与反馈回复相关的一批问题。

新增

  • 设置 > 外观 > 大小 增加“界面文字”四档，只放大侧栏、设置、标签等处的文字，不动边距和控件；对话正文仍由“正文”单独设置。关联 #11577。
  • MCP 工具定义被改动时不必每次点接受：可以对某个服务器选择「跟随」，它的改动直接采用，每次仍会通知；随时可取消。关联 #12356。
  • 需要登录（401）的 MCP 服务器行上有“登录”按钮，点后等待浏览器登录；被暂挡工具旁新增“接受并以后都自动接受这个服务器的改动”，已跟随的服务器可“取消跟随”。关联 #12357。
  • 「我的反馈」的等级卡片里加了一句说明，写清楚「已落地」指反馈已被修复或实现并随新版本发布。修复 #12900 fixed in #13530。
  • 新增（默认关闭）：模型可把任务交给你另一个项目里的会话（dispatch_to_project），对方用户批准后才看到。关联 #13341。
  • 你发过消息的会话，侧栏行和标签上会出现小图标，标明对话走到哪一步（等批准、处理中、已回复、被拒绝），点它跳到该会话。关联 #13371。
  • 设置里有真正的“会话间消息”开关；被拦下的消息可“批准并记住项目”，已记住的项目在设置里一键撤销。保存后下个回合起生效。关联 #13371。
  • 声明 video_models 和 video_protocol 后，read_video 可把 MP4 原生交给能看视频的模型（通义内联、Kimi 上传），卡片显示发给了哪个模型。关联 #13399。
  • 能读图的模型多了 view_image 工具，可直接看工作区里的 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP 文件；不读图的模型不受影响。关联 #13540。
  • 本机读不到网页时，web_fetch 可回退到 DeepSeek 付费抓取接口，需先在卡片上同意；内网地址绝不外发。关联 #13541。
  • 免费搜索没有回答时，web_search 可回退到 DeepSeek 付费搜索接口；首次使用前弹出卡片，写明价格和搜索词，由你同意。关联 #13541。
  • web_search 可用你自己运行的 SearXNG 免费搜索，在用户配置里设置，默认关闭。关联 #13541。
  • 设置 > 工具与权限 里可设置网页搜索和抓取的后端与先后顺序；付费后端的计费同意是单独的开关，不会替你勾选。新开的窗格生效。关联 #13551。
  • 对话里点一个你授权过的额外文件夹里的文件路径，现在能在工作台里只读打开它（不能保存）；文件夹之外的路径仍打不开。关联 #13582 fixed in #13589。
  • 新增用户设置 agent.max_provider_retries：模型接口连接失败后的重试次数，默认仍是 10；设为 0 则一直重试到你取消，适合无人值守的长任务。关联 #13526。
  • 目标现在显示用量：桌面端展开计划栏能看到状态、轮数、请求数、tokens 和用时，停下时说明原因；终端页脚同样显示。关联 #13663。
  • 工作台浏览器里打开本地网页、SVG 或 PDF 文件时，右上角按钮可用系统默认程序打开它，旁边注明网页脚本会照常运行。关联 #13665 fixed in #13668。
  • 编辑器（ACP）新增只读方法 session/info（模型、工作区、预设、自动放行、缓存）和 session/mcpServers（已配置的 MCP 服务器及启用状态）。关联 #13644。
  • 编辑器（ACP）可对单个会话重连、断开 MCP 服务器，并提交扩展表单；项目声明但未获批准的服务器不会被启动，只返回要运行的命令。关联 #13660。
  • 编辑器（ACP）里付费搜索、付费抓取的同意可以选“本会话允许”或“始终允许”（存进你的设置），重连后卡片上仍保留这个选择。关联 #13606。

变更

  • 输入框恢复 1.x 手感：悬停或聚焦时边框扫过一圈光（运行中、系统减弱动画时不播）；框内不再印“空闲/运行中”，状态仍读给读屏软件，运行时钟照旧。关联 #13253 fixed in #13567。
  • 选了人民币或美元显示费用、但模型价格不是官方价目表里的价格时，设置里会说明哪些模型无法换算；服务商页的价格行提供「恢复官方价」，缓存命中价为 0 时提示费用偏低。关联 #13513。
  • 子代理并发数和并行写者数默认不再限制（原为 6 和 3），可在用户配置里设上限；嵌套深度默认 8，设 0 取消。关联 #13526。
  • 会话队列不再限制排队 64 条；想限制时在用户配置里设 agent.max_queued_inputs，队列的字节上限仍然生效。关联 #13526。
  • 侧栏不再限制只能记住 32 个项目；想限制时在用户配置的 [desktop] 里设 max_workspaces。关联 #13526。
  • 左上角品牌标志旁的“STUDIO”徽标由实心深色块改为透明底、细边框、淡色文字，不再像一条提示；外形尺寸不变。关联 #13601。
  • MCP 登录：打开浏览器之前先告诉你服务器要把你带去哪个主机，批准后才打开；可选“始终允许”，只对这个服务器和这个主机生效。关联 #12357。
  • /peer 和会话间消息的接口现在会说明你发出的消息处于等待、处理中、已回复还是被拒绝。关联 #13341。
  • 带图片的排队消息不能在运行中途插入，要等本轮结束；队列里这一行现在写明“含图片，本轮结束后发送”，不再只显示“尚未送达”。关联 #13563。
  • 子代理列表里已结束的任务现在写明状态“已交付”并带上耗时，用绿色标出，不再只显示一个秒数。关联 #13596 fixed in #13599。
  • 配置工作目录时会显示准备的实际阶段、长时间等待、成功、失败重试和取消；失败或取消保留原任务与附件，已有隔离目录也在同一入口可搜。关联 #13598 by @SivanCola。

修复

  • 压缩摘要复用已发送的系统提示和工具目录；纯文本历史还复用对话前缀，含工具的历史继续脱敏。关联 #11860。
  • Windows SSH 远端通过脚本文件启动内核，避免 WMI 的编码命令启动失败，并正确处理中文路径。关联 #12750。
  • 修复输入“/”后技能列表出现很慢的问题（装了大量插件技能时尤其明显）：短时间内的重复补全不再逐个重读技能文件。关联 #13197 fixed in #13470。
  • 辅助会话可收起为标题栏以露出正文，展开后保留草稿、引用和回答；收起不会取消正在进行的请求。关联 #13288。
  • 同一仓库里多个项目声明同名 MCP 服务器（内容不同）时，各自启用互不覆盖，重启后都保持已启用。关联 #13527。
  • 共享事件流迟迟打不开时（旧版内核或代理不认这条路径），窗格 10 秒后改读各自的事件流，页面不再停在“已连接却收不到事件”。关联 #13562 by @tongsailong。
  • 辅助会话面板改为从输入框上方弹出，不再固定在右上角、盖住右侧文件树；按 Esc 或点 × 关闭后焦点回到辅助会话按钮。关联 #13539 fixed in #13557。
  • 两个窗口或项目用同名但启动方式不同的 MCP 服务器时，不再每次启动互相冲掉握手缓存。关联 #13560。
  • 没有代理、读不到版本目录时，打开设置页会让「版本」等上 15 秒；现在各处共用一次读取，失败只记 20 秒，点「重试」才重新读。关联 #13565。
  • 原目录和隔离目录的会话归入同一项目，并标出实际目录；原目录失效时使用仍存在的目录，手动选择隔离目录仍打开该目录。关联 #13586 by @SivanCola。
  • 同一文件夹被写成不同形式（大小写、斜杠方向、末尾分隔符）时，窗格与侧栏项目对不上，标签和列表可能缺少已打开标记；窗格的会话找不到列表行时，日志里会留一行说明。关联 #13600。
  • 断网恢复后，侧栏“进行中”计数不再卡在已经结束的会话上（没打开的窗格也会在网络恢复后重新读到状态）。关联 #13604 fixed in #13623。
  • agent 打开、刷新或翻页内置浏览器时，不再打断你正在进行的输入法输入（拼音不会被当成字母直接上屏）。关联 #13605。
  • agent 打开、导航或显示内置浏览器页面时，不再把你正在输入的键盘焦点抢走；你自己点进那个页面则照常。关联 #13605。
  • 设置页左侧已选中的分区，鼠标停在上面时不再被悬停样式盖掉：浅色主题保持选中底色，两种主题下图标都保持选中时的颜色。关联 #13610。
  • 反馈刚提交、状态还是“已收到”时，如果维护者已经留言提问，现在可以直接在这条下面回复，不必等它被登记为 GitHub 议题；审核中的反馈仍不能回复。关联 #13626。
  • 主会话的模型不读图、子代理的模型读图时，子代理现在也有 view_image 可以看图，不再错用视频工具；父会话的工具表不变。关联 #13642。
  • 命令行里输入斜杠命令时，同一条技能发现警告不再每次按键重复打印、盖住输入行和状态栏；每条警告每个会话只出现一次。关联 #13655。
  • 后台任务一段时间没往自己的输出里写内容时，界面上的警告改成中文，写明任务名和已安静的时长，不再显示英文原文。关联 #13566 fixed in #13568。
  • 多个会话同时运行时，超长输出偶尔被截断的问题。关联 #13620。
  • Windows 上默认端口落在系统保留段（Hyper-V、WSL、Docker）时，网页服务现在会顺延到下一个可用端口，不再直接启动失败。关联 #13649。
  • 网络抖动时读取窗格列表失败，不再关掉所有标签并把你切到别的窗格；共享事件流首次连上后若断开，重连不再漏掉中间的事件。关联 #13603。
  • 会话标题在后台生成时，首条消息改了会重新生成，较慢的旧结果不会盖掉新标题。关联 #13611。
  • 网络、壁纸和账号面板失败时，按界面语言说明原因：不支持的壁纸格式、被拒绝的代理、登录请求已过期都不再显示英文原文或路径加状态码。关联 #13621 by @xxoingr、#13637 by @xxoingr。
  • 会话收件箱的队列暂时读不出来时，不再当成空队列而停止投递，会稍后重试。关联 #13438 by @chuiwenwei。
  • Windows 上读取 PDF 引用超时被取消时，不再因为结束进程命令无响应而卡住。关联 #13614 by @xxoingr。

升级须知

  • 本版无需用户操作。唯一改变默认行为的是子代理并发数和并行写者数不再有默认上限；想保留上限，在用户配置里设置。关联 #13526。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@tongsailong、@xxoingr、@chuiwenwei

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds image and video reading tools for the model, web search and fetch backend settings, a real switch and dispatch for session messages, opening a local page in the default program and a provider retry setting, and fixes a batch of sub-agent, MCP, sidebar, IME and feedback-reply problems.

New

  • Appearance > Size has an Interface text step (small to larger) that enlarges only sidebar, settings and tab text, not spacing or controls; body text keeps its own. Refs #11577.
  • For an MCP server you trust, choose to follow it: its changed tool definitions are taken without a click, each still announced, and you can undo it. Refs #12356.
  • an MCP server that answered 401 has a Sign in button; withheld tools gain "accept and follow this server's changes", and a followed server can be un-followed. Refs #12357.
  • the My feedback level card now says what "shipped" counts: a report that was fixed or built and released in a version. Fixes #12900 fixed in #13530.
  • the model can hand a task to a session in another of your projects (dispatch_to_project); that project's user approves first. Refs #13341.
  • a session you have written to carries a small icon on its row and tab saying where the exchange stands (waiting, working, replied, declined); click it to open that session. Refs #13371.
  • Settings has real session-message switches; a held message can be approved with its project remembered, and revoked in Settings. Applies from the next turn. Refs #13371.
  • declare video_models and video_protocol and read_video hands an MP4 to a model that watches video (DashScope inline, Kimi upload); the card shows which. Refs #13399.
  • a model that reads images gets a view_image tool that shows it a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file in the workspace; text-only models are unchanged. Refs #13540.
  • when this machine cannot read a page, web_fetch can fall back to DeepSeek's paid Fetch API after you agree on a card; internal addresses are never sent. Refs #13541.
  • when the free search did not answer, web_search can fall back to DeepSeek's paid Search API, after a card shows the price and the query and you agree. Refs #13541.
  • web_search can use your own SearXNG instance for free searches, set in your user config, off by default. Refs #13541.
  • Settings > Tools and permissions sets the web search and fetch backends and their order; consent to be billed is its own switch, never ticked for you. New panes only. Refs #13551.
  • A path in the conversation that points into an extra folder you granted now opens read-only in the workbench (no saving); a path outside every granted folder still does not open. Refs #13582 fixed in #13589.
  • Added the user setting agent.max_provider_retries: how often a failed provider connection is retried, still 10 by default; 0 keeps trying until you cancel, for long unattended runs. Refs #13526.
  • A goal now shows its usage: the desktop plan fold lists state, turns, requests, tokens and work time and says why it stopped; the terminal footer shows the same. Refs #13663.
  • A local HTML, SVG or PDF file in the workbench browser can now be opened in the system default program from the toolbar button; a note says page scripts run as usual. Refs #13665 fixed in #13668.
  • ACP gains read-only session/info (model, workspace, preset, auto-approve, cache) and session/mcpServers (configured servers, on or off, no commands). Refs #13644.
  • ACP can reconnect or disconnect an MCP server for one session and submit extension forms; a project-declared server that is not approved is never started, only its command is reported. Refs #13660.
  • In editors (ACP), consent to paid search or fetch can be given for the session or always (saved to your settings), and a reconnected card keeps that choice. Refs #13606.

Changed

  • the composer border sweeps with light on hover or focus as in 1.x (not while running or with reduced motion); the idle/running word is no longer printed but still announced. Refs #13253 fixed in #13567.
  • Settings names models whose price is not in the vendor's list and so cannot be converted to the pinned currency; the price row offers Restore official price. Refs #13513.
  • Sub-agent concurrency and parallel writers are no longer capped by default (were 6 and 3); set limits in your user config. Nesting depth defaults to 8; 0 removes it. Refs #13526.
  • The session queue no longer stops at 64 waiting prompts; set agent.max_queued_inputs in your user config to limit it, and the queue's byte limits still apply. Refs #13526.
  • The sidebar no longer stops at 32 remembered projects; set max_workspaces under [desktop] in your user config to limit it. Refs #13526.
  • The STUDIO badge beside the wordmark is now an outline with muted text instead of a solid dark block; its size is unchanged. Refs #13601.
  • MCP sign-in names the host a server sends you to and asks before the browser opens; "always" is remembered per server and host only. Refs #12357.
  • /peer and the messages-between-sessions API now say whether a message you sent is waiting, being worked on, replied to or declined. Refs #13341.
  • A queued message with a picture cannot join a running turn and waits for it to end; its queue line now says "Has an image: sent when this turn ends", not just "not delivered yet". Refs #13563.
  • A finished sub-agent in the list now says "Handed back" with its time, in green, instead of showing only a number of seconds. Refs #13596 fixed in #13599.
  • Preparing a workspace shows its real stages, success, retry and cancel; a failure or cancel keeps the task and attachments, and existing worktrees are searchable there. Refs #13598 by @SivanCola.

Fixed

  • Compaction reuses the sent system/tool prefix, plus eligible text history. Tool arguments remain elided and oversized or stale requests fall back. Refs #11860.
  • Windows SSH remotes launch the kernel from a UTF-8 script instead of a WMI encoded command, preserving non-ASCII paths. Refs #12750.
  • Fixes the slow skill list after typing "/" (most visible with many plugin skills installed): repeated completions within a moment no longer re-read every skill file. Refs #13197 fixed in #13470.
  • Collapse a side question to read the transcript without losing its draft, quotes, answers or pending request. Refs #13288.
  • projects of one repository that declare an MCP server by the same name with different contents keep their enables side by side across a restart. Refs #13527.
  • when the shared event stream never opens (an older kernel, or a proxy), panes read their own streams after 10 seconds instead of staying silent. Refs #13562 by @tongsailong.
  • the side-conversation panel now opens above the composer instead of sitting at the top right over the file tree; Esc or the close cross returns focus to its button. Refs #13539 fixed in #13557.
  • two windows or projects using an MCP server of the same name but a different launch spec no longer evict each other's handshake cache on every start. Refs #13560.
  • With no proxy and an unreachable version catalog, opening Settings kept Versions waiting 15 s; callers now share one read, a failure is kept 20 s, and Retry reads again. Refs #13565.
  • source and worktree chats share one project with checkout labels. A surviving checkout replaces a missing source; picking a worktree still opens it. Refs #13586 by @SivanCola.
  • A folder spelled two ways (case, slashes, trailing separator) no longer splits a pane from its sidebar project; a pane with no row for its conversation now leaves a log line. Refs #13600.
  • after a network flap the sidebar's running count no longer sticks on conversations that finished; a pane you have not opened reads its status again once the network is back. Refs #13604 fixed in #13623.
  • the agent opening, reloading or navigating the built-in browser no longer cuts off an input-method composition in progress (the pinyin is no longer committed as raw letters). Refs #13605.
  • the agent opening, navigating or showing a built-in browser page no longer takes the keyboard from what you are typing in; clicking into that page yourself still works. Refs #13605.
  • The selected settings section keeps its look while the pointer rests on it: its fill in the light theme, and its icon colour in both themes. Refs #13610.
  • A "received" report can be answered from its thread once a maintainer has written to it, without waiting to be filed as an issue; one under review still takes no reply. Refs #13626.
  • A sub-agent on an image-reading model now gets view_image even if the session's model cannot read images; the parent's tool block is unchanged. Refs #13642.
  • Typing slash commands no longer reprints the same skill-discovery warning on every keystroke over the input line and status bar; each warning appears once per session. Refs #13655.
  • the warning about a background job that has been silent on its own output is now worded in the interface language, with the job name and how long it has been quiet. Refs #13566 fixed in #13568.
  • Oversize output was occasionally truncated when several sessions ran at once. Refs #13620.
  • On Windows, when the default port falls in a range the system reserves (Hyper-V, WSL, Docker), the web server now moves on to the next free port instead of failing to start. Refs #13649.
  • A failed pane-list read in a network blip no longer closes every tab, and a shared stream that drops right after its first attach no longer loses events. Refs #13603.
  • Session titles generated in the background are asked again when the first message changes, and a slower older result no longer overwrites the newer title. Refs #13611.
  • Network, wallpaper and account panels word their failures in the interface language instead of English text or a path and a status. Refs #13621 by @xxoingr, #13637 by @xxoingr.
  • When the session inbox queue cannot be read for a moment, delivery no longer stops as if it were empty; it retries shortly. Refs #13438 by @chuiwenwei.
  • On Windows, cancelling a timed-out PDF reference extraction no longer hangs when the process-kill command does not answer. Refs #13614 by @xxoingr.

Upgrade notes

  • No action is needed. The only default that changed is that sub-agent concurrency and parallel writers are no longer capped; set limits in your user config to keep them. Refs #13526.

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

v18.12.1 Stable2026-10-17T23:14:21Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed

  • Fixed every request failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy that refuses compressed uploads: a 400/403/415 whose body is not JSON, or the Anthropic API's "request body is not valid JSON" after a proxy drops Content-Encoding, now resends the body uncompressed and stops compressing for that host (#16108 by @alphastorm)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed

  • Anthropic's request-encoding-rejection now also matches the API's "request body is not valid JSON" 400, which a gzip body gets when a proxy drops its Content-Encoding header (#16108 by @alphastorm)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Breaking Changes

  • Removed display() from eval in both Python and JavaScript; print (and console.log in JavaScript) covers it

Added

  • Added advisor.continueSeverity (nit, concern, blocker) to choose the minimum advisor note severity that wakes the agent after it finished with a final answer; lower-severity notes stay as a card at the end of the transcript
  • Printed DataFrames/Series render as tables, large dicts/lists and objects as JSON trees, and Markdown objects as Markdown for the user, while the model sees the printed text
  • Printing a figure or image in eval attaches the image to the result

Changed

  • An advisor concern raised after the agent's final answer now continues the run by default instead of waiting at the end of the transcript; set advisor.continueSeverity to blocker for the previous behavior

Fixed

  • Fixed context-file @ imports failing to load paths containing backslash-escaped spaces (#16090)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Fixed

  • Fixed native memory growing without bound, and eventually crashing the process, when files in a downloaded (WASM) grammar language such as C# were parsed repeatedly (#16067)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Breaking Changes

  • numberedCode, readContentCode and nativeDiff take the file's path (path) instead of a language, and describeGroupedOutput drops its lang option: Tern picks the grammar of file contents from their path

Changed

  • Advisor notes in Tern read as a callout tinted by their worst severity: its icon and a tally (Concern, 1 blocker · 2 concerns) head the card with the advisor's name at the end, and several notes each lead with their own severity icon

Fixed

  • Fixed images rendering blank inside tmux on Kitty-capable terminals when tmux's allow-passthrough is off (the default); omp now falls back to SIXEL or the text placeholder instead of sending Kitty graphics tmux drops
  • Fixed Tern drawing tool cards' file contents (write, read, edit, grep, find, ast-grep, ast-edit) plain or in the wrong language when omp did not know the file's extension (.ptx) or mapped it to a neighbor (.cu as C++); omp now sends the file's path and Tern picks the grammar

What's Changed

  • fix(ai): resend uncompressed when a proxy rejects a compressed request body by @alphastorm in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16108
  • fix(tui): answered allow-passthrough in fake tmux client fixture by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16112
  • fix(ast): retired per-thread wasm parser store after a byte budget by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16078
  • fix(coding-agent): support escaped spaces in context imports by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16091

v18.12.0 Stable2026-10-17T18:44:02Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Fixed

  • Fixed Cursor turns failing with PROVIDER_ERROR when a follow-up (a finished background job, a late diagnostic, a reminder) arrived while the previous turn was still streaming (#15821 by @robfeldmann)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Breaking Changes

  • PI_CODEX_ZSTD is replaced by PI_REQUEST_COMPRESSION; set PI_REQUEST_COMPRESSION=0 to send Codex (and every other) request body uncompressed (#16086 by @H4vC)

Added

  • Added ThinkingContent.narration, set on Anthropic and Bedrock thinking blocks whose signature marks them as between-tool narration, and presentNarrationAsAnswer(message) to show those blocks as reply text while replay keeps them as signed thinking
  • Added keys.peek(provider, { includeExpired: true }) to name the stored account behind an expired OAuth token for reads that never send it, such as keying an offline model-cache lookup (#16061 by @gchai)
  • Added prewarmModelConnection(model) (providers/connection-prewarm), which opens the model's API connection ahead of a request using the same transport and TLS settings so the request reuses it instead of paying the connection handshake (#16086 by @H4vC)

Changed

  • Anthropic requests to the official API now gzip the request body, so long conversations reach the model sooner on slow uplinks; set PI_REQUEST_COMPRESSION=0 to disable it (#16044 by @H4vC)
  • GitHub Copilot requests (chat completions, Responses, and Claude messages) now send zstd-compressed bodies, cutting upload size by roughly 60–75% on long conversations; set PI_REQUEST_COMPRESSION=0 to disable it (#16086 by @H4vC)
  • A rejected request-body encoding now only disables compression for that host, and only after the uncompressed resend succeeds, so a genuine 400 no longer turns compression off (#16086 by @H4vC)
  • Connection warm-up now covers every catalog provider, not only the official Anthropic API: it re-warms the origin a model's requests actually reach (Copilot plan hosts, MOONSHOT_BASE_URL, regional hosts), throttled per host; custom providers, built-in provider ids routed to a gateway, local hosts, and Anthropic gateways are never probed (#16086 by @H4vC)

Fixed

  • Fixed Ollama and Ollama Cloud streaming errors being silently accepted as successful responses (#16039 by @mottopanikeiku)
  • Fixed the hermes in-band scanner exposing a truncated tool name for streaming tool calls: toolStart now waits for the complete JSON name, so a stream that splits or stops mid-name never reports a partial tool name (#16064 by @adi-IL)
  • Fixed keys.peek() rotating through stored accounts on each call; it now returns the first account whose token has not expired, every time, so model discovery keeps reading one account's cached catalog (#16061 by @gchai)
  • Fixed local JSON Schema references with URI-percent-encoded, JSON Pointer-escaped, or empty definition names resolving incorrectly during dereferencing, strict conversion, and value validation (#15926 by @jchanghong023).
  • Fixed network failures showing a generic "Connection error."; offline, connection-refused, and TLS-verification failures now name the host and the cause (#16036 by @jorgoose)
  • Fixed Jev image limits rejecting inputs for unrelated native judges and redundant TypeSafe image judgments when only detail changes (#16002 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • Fixed SIGTERM interrupting an in-flight OAuth token rotation before its replacement refresh token was saved (#15845).
  • Fixed sessions getting stuck on HTTP 400 after replaying tool names unsupported by the target provider, including invented proc://* calls and Google tool names sent to Bedrock (#15839)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added

  • Added the request-encodings, request-encoding-rejection, and endpoint-hosts rule axes, resolveRequestCompression(model, url), and isCatalogEndpointUrl(model, url), declaring which providers' own endpoints decode compressed request bodies: official Anthropic API (gzip), Codex backend (zstd), and GitHub Copilot's API hosts (zstd, then gzip); Moonshot's China host counts as its own endpoint (#16086 by @H4vC)

Changed

  • Bundled GPT-5.4 rows on OpenAI, Azure, OpenCode Zen, and Command Code report a 1M context window, the window the coding agent already applied at runtime; GitHub Copilot and Factory Droid keep their own windows (#16094 by @H4vC)

Fixed

  • Fixed custom providers that declare a built-in providerType (Azure, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, ClinePass, DeepSeek, NVIDIA) missing that provider's wire quirks, such as strict Responses pairing and the ClinePass reasoning field: they now follow the same catalog rules as the built-in provider (#16093 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed OpenCode Zen bringing back its retired bundled models after a failed refresh: the retry-backoff write no longer drops the cached snapshot's retention, so the pruned catalog survives the retry window and offline launches. (#16054 by @adi-IL)
  • Fixed providers.cacheWarming never arming for Claude on Google Antigravity: Claude models there now declare Vertex Anthropic's five-minute prompt-cache lifetime; Gemini models stay unwarmed because Google's implicit cache has no fixed lifetime (#15764, #16025 by @harshaygadekar)
  • Scoped Jev image bounds to the selected models instead of applying them to unrelated native judges (#16002 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Fixed Bedrock sessions rejecting replayed tool names over 64 characters after a model switch (#15839)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Added statusLine.segmentOptions.pi.showProfile: set it to false to hide the profile name next to the π brand, for example when each profile already has its own theme (#16063 by @shgew)
  • Added sharpshooter.minPromptLength (default 16, minimum 2) to control the shortest prompt Sharpshooter extracts decisions from (#16043 by @bigHippoZz)

Changed

  • With a first-party Anthropic model on the official API selected, the interactive UI opens the API connection at startup, on model switch, and when you start typing, so the next turn skips connection setup; third-party gateways and custom endpoints are never probed (#16044 by @H4vC)
  • The API connection warm-up now covers every built-in provider (Copilot, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, …), not only Anthropic: between turns it keeps the connection your last request used open, through the configured proxy and CA settings, so the next turn skips connection setup; custom models.yml providers, built-in providers pointed at a gateway, and local servers are never probed (#16086 by @H4vC)
  • Snapcompact now shows an imaged read result's indentation as count brackets ([»2] two tabs, [·4] four spaces) and keeps its [path#TAG] header as text, so edits from imaged reads keep the right indentation and tag (#15899 by @apoc)
  • A custom model's explicit contextWindow or maxTokens in models.yml now wins over the catalog's limit rules for that model id, which previously overwrote it (#16094 by @H4vC)

Fixed

  • Fixed Claude Opus 5.5 replies sent between tool calls (for example an answer to a question asked mid-task) being folded into the "Thought" block; they now show as normal reply text in the transcript, print mode, ACP clients, and HTML exports
  • Fixed the shell's du --time=ctime (also status) printing ??? on Windows; it now shows the last write time, as stat already does for the status-change time
  • Fixed the shell's rmdir dir/. on Windows removing dir (and rmdir x/.. the parent); like POSIX it now fails with Invalid argument / Directory not empty
  • Fixed the shell's dd if=DIR on Windows failing with failed to open ...: Permission denied; like POSIX it now opens the directory and reports error reading ...: Is a directory with the transfer statistics
  • Fixed the LSP mux returning from shutdown before its language-server children exited, and spawning a duplicate language server when a session reconnected while the previous one was still closing its documents
  • Fixed the startup connection warm-up silently doing nothing on Windows, where Bun's fetch.preconnect throws (#16086 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed the RPC frame codec (modes/rpc/rpc-frame) failing to bundle for Node because it pulled in Bun-only modules and the native addon (#16072 by @oyty)
  • Fixed auth-gateway strict probes sending a raw token instead of the structured credential blob for Alibaba Coding Plan and Snowflake logins (#16092 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed a prompt sent while Esc was still interrupting the previous turn never settling, so a message steered in as it ended stayed queued instead of running (#16038 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed isolated tasks freezing the host when the checkout holds linked worktrees of the same repository (e.g. gitignored .claude/worktrees/); those worktrees are no longer snapshotted as nested repos (#16068)
  • Fixed edit moves dropping executable permissions in hashline, patch, and apply_patch modes (#16042 by @mottopanikeiku)
  • Fixed leaving a subagent view before its transcript finished replaying leaving rows of both sessions on screen, dropping the start of one, and clearing native scrollback twice; transcript rebuilds now run one at a time and a superseded rebuild is discarded without painting (#16066 by @cagedbird043)
  • Fixed Cursor task subagents losing their final report when it follows tool calls in the same turn (#16059).
  • Fixed SQLite read continuation hints dropping filters and sort order or truncating the next-page selector (#16040 by @mottopanikeiku)
  • Fixed SQLite table reads omitting generated columns from sample rows and query results, and rejecting sort orders on those columns (#16041 by @mottopanikeiku)
  • Fixed video timestamp selectors (clip.mp4:2s, clip.mp4:0:05) failing for files outside the session cwd, which also reported a colon-mangled path when the video was missing. (#16056 by @adi-IL)
  • Fixed recovery of hashed session directories for projects under a temporary directory inside home, including the default Windows temp directory (#15929 by @jchanghong023).
  • Fixed approval prompts for xd:// device dispatches and direct MCP tools to show readable, indented arguments with multiline content expanded into blocks (#15589, #16048 by @KunoLu).
  • Fixed retry.fallbackChains warning "references unknown model" at startup for models a discovery provider loads once its background refresh finishes (e.g. Copilot and Cursor -1m variants); a model still missing after discovery is warned about once (#16061 by @gchai)
  • Fixed GitHub Copilot models that only discovery lists (e.g. -1m variants) going missing at startup when two Copilot accounts are signed in (#16061 by @gchai)
  • Fixed Cursor models that only discovery lists (e.g. -1m variants) staying unavailable at startup until a background refresh whenever the stored Cursor access token had expired; the startup cache read now uses the same account key as the discovery write (#16061 by @gchai)
  • Fixed var declared inside a top-level control block disappearing after an awaited JavaScript Eval cell (#15859).
  • Fixed the eval runtime-state reminder omitting live Python kernels, so retained Python state no longer reads as dead or absent; Python kernels are listed with their generation, alive/dead status, and %load scripts like JavaScript kernels (#16032).
  • Fixed a browser call hanging for about 21 s, and its tab staying listed but dead, when the tab's worker crashed (such as on an error inside Puppeteer): the call fails at once with the cause and the next call continues on the same page (#16037 by @alnaggar-dev and @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed /restart losing explicitly opened session files outside the default session directories by resuming the persisted file directly (#16030 by @appboypov)
  • Fixed a failed todo call's hidden reminder resurfacing on the next prompt with an outdated list after the agent had already retried successfully (#16001)
  • Fixed TypeSafe image-cache reuse when only ignored image detail changes (#16002 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Fixed ssh:// ignoring a ControlPath from ~/.ssh/config, so it now reuses an already-authenticated master (e.g. on MFA/keyboard-interactive hosts) instead of failing with Permission denied (#15974)
  • Fixed --session-dir <dir> --resume <id> not finding a transcript that is a symlink in that directory, the session lists and id-prefix lookups skipping symlinked transcripts the same way, and a resume that must rewrite such a transcript replacing the link instead of updating the file it points at; a project bucket that is itself a symlink is no longer traversed, so a scan cannot leave the sessions root and no session is listed twice (#15878, #15882 by @AnxForever)
  • Fixed restarting an interactive session with SIGTERM disabling a rotating Anthropic OAuth login and requiring /login again (#15845).
  • Fixed URL read dropping everything past 500,000 characters: tail selectors, URL grep, and the linked full-output artifact now reach the whole response body (#15768).
  • Fixed find (tool and omp find) reporting "no hits" when every judge request failed; it now reports find unavailable with a hint to use grep, flags partial runs with how many judge requests failed, and exposes the status as coverage in its details and --json output (#15744)
  • Fixed resumed sessions with eval history (--continue, --resume) missing the prompt cache after the previous process's first request (#15736)
  • Fixed a failed streamed edit preview ending the whole run without retry: the harness now re-drives the turn with the preview diagnostic so the model can read the file again and correct the patch, and gives up with a notice only after two recoveries
  • Fixed MCP OAuth login requesting every scope in an authorization server's catalogue when the protected resource advertises no scopes; /mcp reauth now falls back to configured scopes or authorization-server defaults (#15996 by @unclesamwk).
  • Fixed the incomplete-todo stop reminder firing (and resuming work) when the agent's final message asks for permission or a decision before a closing status line, through "If you confirm, I'll…"/"Separately, tell me…"-style requests, or with a non-English question followed by another sentence (#15986)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Breaking Changes

  • encodeSixel and encodeSixelAsync now require a fourth terminal-background RGB argument packed as 0xRRGGBB (#15891 by @Bouska).

Fixed

  • Fixed Windows file-lock contention returning permission errors when an existing lease allows synchronization but not full mutex access (#15930 by @jchanghong023).
  • Fixed SIXEL images dropping translucent details or showing dark, discolored edges when resized, while preserving fully transparent pixels (#15891 by @Bouska).

@oh-my-pi/omptype

Fixed

  • Fixed TypeBox numeric bounds written in exponent notation throwing during schema construction, while preserving validation and nested JSON Schema constraints (#15925 by @jchanghong023).
  • Fixed importing local JSON Schema definition references containing URI percent encoding or JSON Pointer escapes (#15926 by @jchanghong023).

@oh-my-pi/omp-stats

Fixed

  • Fixed usage stats pricing Google Antigravity and MiniMax Token Plan models at $0 when their catalog rows carry no price; they now use the catalog's pricing peer, as xai-oauth already did (#16092 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Breaking Changes

  • FindStats.errors is replaced by failed (judge requests that failed) and unanswered (unusable answers), and FindToolDetails requires a coverage status; the find renderer shows N/M requests failed (#15744)

Added

  • Added pi.showProfile to StatusLineSegmentOptions: false keeps the pi segment's bare glyph under a named profile, in the rendered bar and in describe (#16063 by @shgew)

Fixed

  • Fixed sessions run inside tmux silently falling back to the terminal's true-color profile when the client terminal-type probe answered slowly on a loaded machine (#16020 by @CharleoYang)
  • Fixed the read result notice printing the absolute resolved path, so a file under the home directory reads Resolved path: ~/notes.txt instead of /home/you/notes.txt (#16055 by @adi-IL).
  • Fixed grep/read previews and other tool cards passing raw escape sequences from file contents to the terminal, which could switch it to the alternate screen with mouse reporting on, live and again on every resume (#15963)
  • Fixed a final status-line render after shutdown scheduling another usage refresh (#15845).
  • Fixed Ctrl+O on LSP status and other plain LSP responses still clipping every row at 80 columns; expanded rows now wrap to show the full text (#15824)
  • Fixed Ctrl+O leaving long rows clipped in expanded LSP, debug, MCP, web search fallback, yield, task and custom-tool results; expanded rows now wrap to show the full text, expanded LSP references list every location, and the LSP expand hint no longer appears when nothing is hidden (#15824)
  • Fixed jagged text and disappearing translucent details in SIXEL images, including re-encoding when the terminal reports a changed background color (#15891 by @Bouska).
  • Fixed stale SIXEL backgrounds after terminal restarts, native appearance changes, and failed TSP handshakes, including background changes during the handshake, fixed themes, missing or invalid startup themes, or identical light/dark mappings (#15891 by @Bouska).

Fixed
